policy: Official-source resource collections only. These are source/catalog resources, not individual books and do not inflate the book count.

resources.title: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS)
resources.notes: Long-term archive of peer-reviewed, documented planetary mission, ground-based, and laboratory data products.

resources.title: NASA Earthdata Search
resources.notes: Discovery interface for NASA Earth observation collections and granules across atmosphere, biosphere, climate, cryosphere, land, oceans, solid Earth and hydrosphere.

resources.title: NASA Planetary Data Sites and Repositories
resources.notes: NASA-maintained registry of planetary science data sites and repositories; includes PDS and Astromat and requires listed resources to be publicly available.

resources.title: USDA NASS Quick Stats
resources.notes: USDA NASS searchable agricultural statistics database covering commodities, locations and time periods.

resources.title: USDA NASS Large Datasets
resources.notes: Downloadable agricultural statistics datasets published by NASS.

resources.title: USDA PLANTS Database
resources.notes: Standardized U.S. plant names, taxonomy, symbols, distribution, characteristics, images, crop information and references.
